# Swop

> Swop is a self-custodial crypto wallet and social trading app on Solana, Ethereum,
> Base, and Polygon. It combines a gas-sponsored wallet (no SOL or ETH needed for
> fees), token swaps, perpetual futures, prediction markets, in-person crypto
> payments (SwopPay, 0.5% checkout fee), and an AI trading agent that proposes
> trades but never signs without user approval. Keys stay on the user's device.

## Key pages
- [Swop home](https://www.swopme.co): product overview
- [Web app](https://swopme.app): the Swop wallet in the browser
- [Blog](https://www.swopme.co/blog): Swop Journal — product, markets, engineering
- [Agentic trading launch](https://www.swopme.co/blog/agentic-trading-is-live): how Swop's AI agent and its confirmation model work
- [Self-custody wallet, explained](https://www.swopme.co/blog/self-custody-wallet-solana): what self-custody means on Solana and what to check before choosing a wallet
- [Gasless crypto, explained](https://www.swopme.co/blog/gasless-crypto-wallet): how sponsored-transaction ("gasless") wallets actually work, and what to check before trusting one
- [Is Swop safe?](https://www.swopme.co/blog/is-swop-safe): who holds the keys, what requires your signature, and what Swop's AI agent can and can't do without you
- [Swop vs Phantom](https://www.swopme.co/blog/swop-vs-phantom): a neutral feature comparison — custody, chains, gas fees, in-person payments, and AI agent design
- [Support](https://support.swop.id): help and documentation
- [About](https://www.swopme.co/about.html): company and team
